lead: Sadhana Shivdasani was an Indian actor, born on 2 September 1941 in Karachi.
She died on 25 December 2015 in Mumbai at the age of 74.
She is associated with work such as Love in Simla, Parakh and Asli-Naqli and has been recognised with the IIFA Lifetime Achievement Award.
This profile collects the Sadhana facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Sadhana Shivdasani — Career and Professional Work
paras: Sadhana Shivdasani works primarily as a film director and film actor.
